generalFindings: Integrity: all 102 obligation texts in matrix-pre.json equal the frozen plan VP-e77a2134e1b0 (4b38213), and all 49 NOT_RUN statuses equal the frozen traceability.json. Note: final.json names the curated plan VP-5d1202ddec1e (indy-init cf328bb) while traceability.json uses VP-e77a2134e1b0; the matrix follows the latter.

Agent statements used as verification: all 284 agent commits in the rehearsal repository are authored 'Claude', and every one carrying a session trailer (203) names session_01G1iECdHZXLR6xBfMivMsx3, reviews included. 'Independent reviewer', 'T33 reviewer closed F-1/DCT-LIVE-A', 'owner decided in chat', 'two container restarts' and 'bootstrap without hand workaround' all rest on agent-authored text. None of the five A classifications strictly depends on them (they rest on CI and post-rehearsal tests), but AR-008, AR-024, VER-003, AR-015 and EXT-DATA-006's narrative do.

deployed-compare.tsv is mis-measured: 193 of its 198 DIFF rows carry the GitHub Pages 404 body hash b620507312c5e975..., confirmed by fetching a missing URL. The comparison requested the local rebuild's fingerprinted file names from a site built separately (b972cb4, 06:22Z), so it shows a non-deterministic or different build, not 198 changed artifacts. Any matrix text citing '198 of 263 artifacts changed' (AR-011) should be restated.

Frozen decision DEC-025 (OD-INDY-10: no anonymous mode; permission fields advisory; CI token has contents write) bears on EXT-DATA-005-O1, EXT-DATA-006-O2, PF-015-O1 and PF-015-O2, and the matrix never cites it. The plan kept obligations that contradict it, which is a plan-correction item.

Pre-run and agent-local evidence (indy-init preflight-run-r5-local.json, kickoff preflight-record.json) carries no run_id or source_sha, so under the evidence contract's mustMatch it cannot be admissible run evidence. All six 'existingEvidenceAtDeadline: sufficient' claims were checked: only EXT-DATA-006 holds (CI results from run 40620099844 at 1b9fb56, live job in the same run, missing only the binding). AR-020, AR-023, UI-021, UI-040 and VER-004 should be 'insufficient'.

Primary-cause convention is inconsistent. Where the audit itself finds the implementation incomplete (B), it sometimes records 4 (insufficient assertions: UI-011-O4, UI-016-O11, EXT-DATA-005-O1) and sometimes 1 (UI-031-O5, AR-011-O2, PF-015-O1). If the implementation is incomplete, a sufficient test would fail, so the primary cause should be 1 and 4 secondary.

They are well constructed (non-vacuity control, model-equality assertions), but they cover only what they assert: no branch or repository permission check, and no provider (fixture to GitHub) switch.
